result:
All 37 tests pass, and the only new/changed file is `CSVParserAgentTest.java` (the pre-existing deletion of `CSVParserTest.java` was already present before I started).

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVParserAgentTest.java` covering `CSVParser`'s public API:

- All static `parse(...)` factories (String, Reader, File, Path, InputStream, URL) plus their null-argument `NullPointerException` cases
- Deprecated public constructors (`Reader,Format` and `Reader,Format,offset,recordNumber`)
- `Builder` (default format, record-number seeding, byte/character offset behavior including the byte-offset-defaults-to-character-offset rule)
- `getRecords()`, `stream()`, `iterator()` (`hasNext`/`next` ordering, exhaustion, `remove()` unsupported, behavior after `close()`)
- Header handling: `getHeaderMap()` (including case-insensitive mode and copy-semantics), `getHeaderNames()`, missing/duplicate header name error cases, `DuplicateHeaderMode.ALLOW_ALL`
- Header/trailer comments (`hasHeaderComment`, `getHeaderComment`, `hasTrailerComment`, `getTrailerComment`)
- `getCurrentLineNumber()`, `getFirstEndOfLine()`, `getRecordNumber()`, `isClosed()`/`close()`
- `maxRows` truncation behavior
- Malformed input (unterminated quote) surfacing as `UncheckedIOException` wrapping `CSVException`

Style matches the existing suite: JUnit 5 (Jupiter), package-private class, static-import assertions, `@TempDir` for filesystem tests, try-with-resources for parsers.
